# RIM Online Agent Instructions

The agent contract for this repository lives in [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md). Read it before
making any change. It defines the source-of-truth order (the RIM-2013b Excel workbook, not the
Python code), the `rim/` vs `pages/` layering, the `simulate_strategy()` result contract, and
the parity-fixture rules.

Durable project facts are in [`.claude/memory/`](../.claude/memory/MEMORY.md).
